source_findings: gsr_nr.cpp submit() always calls finishGpu(), which signals a completion fence and blocks the CPU in waitCompletion(). Both evaluation and presentation use submit().
nr_interop.cpp consume() separately signals a D3D12-to-D3D11 fence, enqueues D3D11 Wait, then queues the output CopyResource. Successful evaluation transport already has GPU dependency ordering.
One command allocator/list is reused; allocator Reset must remain protected by prior GPU completion.
Failed SDK tagging/evaluation skips consume(); a deferred-wait design must keep or restore a blocking completion path there and on transport exceptions.
Configure, resize, guide extent changes and shutdown drain resources before release/reuse; those drains must remain.
Native GuestDispatch is elapsed inclusive time and can contain VU/DMA/bridge waits; current evidence does not identify a specific CPU function or establish a pure EE CPU bottleneck.
Existing hostprof.csv files predate current uncapped candidates and cannot establish the present native hotspot.

diagnostic_change.format: Fixed bounded counters; calls/inclusive_ms/exclusive_ms/max_ms plus blockedWaits; disabled scopes do not read clock.
diagnostic_change.source_review: Underlying execution-operation token sequence matches HEAD after removing only added scopes, profile storage/class, and blocked-wait accounting.

proposed_bounded_optimization.status: Proposal only; await phase evidence before policy implementation.
proposed_bounded_optimization.design: Experimentally defer CPU completion only for successful NR evaluation; retain GPU queue fences/copy ordering. Wait on the last submitted fence before allocator/list reuse. Keep presentation submit synchronous and all lifecycle/failure drains intact.
preserved: Same actual NR evaluations, model, strength, dimensions, guides, history/reset and pixels
No change to guest cycles/vblank/timestep/audio, uncapped setting, frame credits or repeat presents
No change to texture coherence or fidelity
proposed_bounded_optimization.risk: May merely move the same wait into presentation rather than increase throughput; device-loss and failed-evaluation cleanup need explicit validation. No speedup claim.

questions: How much evalSubmit elapsed is completionWait rather than SDK CPU recording/transport?
Does presentation consume substantial synchronous completion time?
If NR completion dominates, validate any deferred-wait variant with the same frozen candidate/config, successful-evaluation counts, pixels, clock audit and matched unique-world throughput.
